CardHeader.CardDescription: Demo is read only. Press send to start a new conversation.

MessageScroller.Message: Hi! How can I help you today?
I'm trying to add auto-scroll to my chat UI.
Wrap your messages in a MessageScroller and it will scroll to the newest content automatically.
Does it still let me scroll up to read older messages?
Yes, you can scroll away freely while it's not actively streaming new content.
That's exactly what I needed, thanks!
